title: Reproducibility supplement for the revised data quality application profile
description: Evidence catalogue for the supplied assessments, executed local checks, historical report-table secondary analysis, source comparisons and prepared integration materials. Evidence status is stated per component so that a prepared runner, public platform source and completed study measurement are not conflated.
path_base: All artifact paths are relative to the directory containing this catalogue.

publication.note: The project already exists and is the intended destination. This local preparation is not evidence of a published study deposit. The platform reference tag/commit recorded below identifies external source configuration, not this supplement.

evidence_status_guide.supplied_transcription_with_executed_loc: The distributed assertions have been reconstructed and checked; the underlying matching laboratory reports are not authenticated.
evidence_status_guide.executed_local_checks: Captured local execution results for the application-specific constraints or representations.
evidence_status_guide.executed_synthetic_local_checks: Executed deterministic fixtures; no empirical sensor error-rate or operational deployment claim.

evidence_status_guide.executed_synthetic_local_benchmark: Captured repeated local processing measurements with the stated workload and exclusions.
evidence_status_guide.executed_report_table_recovery_and_secon: Recovered report rows, independently checked transcription, and descriptive statistics with author annotations and retained provenance limits.
evidence_status_guide.document_comparison_with_version_boundar: Comparison of the identified complete author manuscript; publisher-version identity is not established.
evidence_status_guide.inspected_public_source_configuration: Public platform source inspected at the pinned reference; not a running-deployment attestation.
evidence_status_guide.prepared_integration_with_executed_offli: Prepared runner and completed offline tests, plus recorded access failures; no successful study broker experiment.
evidence_status_guide.prepared_not_executed: Executable recipe supplied without a successful captured execution.
evidence_status_guide.adopted_policy_with_primary_legal_source: A declared revision policy supported by identified primary law; not newly recovered historical report methodology.

components.title: Captured local representation-cost experiment

configuration.context_accounting: one shared inline context counted once in each archive
configuration.scope: In-memory serialization, SHA-256 and test-key Ed25519 only; no network, disk, database, query, subscription or connector timings
configuration.closed_window_delay: Up to 60 seconds plus actual processing; retrospective archive scoring only

components.interpretation: Raw results are timing-run records for an in-memory synthetic archive. Times cover serialization, SHA-256 and test-key Ed25519 signing, not policy evaluation, signature verification, parsing, network, broker, database, subscriptions or connectors. Bytes are an analytical sum of serialized components with one shared context per archive, not a complete HTTP body or measured stored size. Window evidence is retrospective after closure.

components.title: H2022 historical report-table recovery and descriptive agreement analysis

analysis_method.pairing: Pairs exactly as printed in a source row; no temporal rejoin or alignment correction.
analysis_method.weighting: Equal weight for each complete row; gaps do not create synthetic observations.
analysis_method.pearson_r: centred cross-product divided by square root of centred sums of squares
analysis_method.ols: sensor = intercept + slope*reference; ordinary least squares with an intercept
analysis_method.ols_justification: Each series has at least two complete pairs and nonzero reference variance; descriptive projection only, no error-free-reference or causal assertion.
analysis_method.missingness: Exclude incomplete rows from pair statistics only; preserve them in recovered CSVs.

components.interpretation: H2022 denotes the report cover date, not a common observation year. HS1-HS8 label annex series, not eight established physical units. Literal source dates, numeric strings and unknown annex-unit fields are preserved. Author-confirmed effective units are a separate annotation for seven pollutants; PM1 retains an unconfirmed physical unit. Date/station/device mapping and selected printed summary discrepancies remain. The rows support transparent descriptive agreement, not new certification, temporal realignment, current-cohort attribution or expanded-uncertainty estimates.
components.reproduction_boundary: Descriptive results can be recomputed from the bundled CSVs. Re-extraction and the source-PDF verification additionally require the separately held original PDF with the recorded digest.
